notes.canvas: Floating numbers are drawn on the canvas, which reads no template or stylesheet, so the gallery has nothing to render. Their colors are in the color section.
notes.chatFrame: The frame is core's chat message; the message header with speaker and time is added only in the chat log.
notes.dialogFrame: The dialog's content as the roll opens it. Core adds the window frame and buttons; the dialogs pattern opens one.
notes.dialogPattern: The check dialog in core's dialog frame. Its button only closes it.
notes.editor: Notes show their read-only form: the editor needs a document to save to.
notes.expandRoll: Press a dice row to show its dice, as in the chat log.
notes.invalidWarningLocked: No template has an invalid, warning, or locked field yet: those states are targets of the design system.
notes.loading: No control shows a loading state yet.
notes.pseudoStates: Hover, focus, and press: use the pointer or the keyboard on the sample.
notes.readOnly: A sheet the viewer cannot edit disables its controls when the sheet renders, so the samples show the editable form.
notes.reveal: Row controls are hidden until the pointer is over the row.
notes.surface: Ratios are measured in the window's theme. The surface is core's window background, so its reference value from color.md stands in for it.
notes.woundConfig: The editable track lives in the Wound configuration window, which needs an actor to open.
